title: Accountants and auditors
rationale: By 2036, AI autonomously handles audit procedures, tax preparation, compliance checking, and financial statement analysis. The remaining human role is concentrated in advisory relationships, novel strategic financial guidance, and situations requiring professional judgment in ambiguous ethical or regulatory territory.

title: Actors
rationale: Acting is fundamentally a physical and interpersonal performance art where human embodiment and emotional authenticity are the product. AI can generate synthetic performances and deepfakes, but live theater, on-set collaboration, and the cultural value of human authorship preserve most of the role. Some voiceover and background work is displaced.

title: Actuaries
rationale: Actuarial modeling, risk calculation, data analysis, and regulatory reporting are fully automatable digital tasks by 2036. The remaining human role is in novel product design, interpreting ambiguous regulatory environments, and communicating complex risk trade-offs to executive stakeholders.

title: Administrative services and facilities managers
rationale: The administrative coordination, records management, supply chain ordering, and scheduling components are fully automated by AI agents. However, the facilities management side involving physical building oversight, vendor relationship management, and on-site problem-solving retains a meaningful human role.

title: Adult basic and secondary education and ESL teachers
rationale: Content delivery, curriculum planning, and assessment can be fully automated by AI tutoring systems. However, adult learners often need motivational support, cultural sensitivity, and interpersonal connection that keeps human teachers relevant, especially for vulnerable populations learning English.

title: Advertising sales agents
rationale: Programmatic advertising and AI-driven media buying have already eroded this role. By 2036, AI agents handle client prospecting, campaign proposal generation, pricing optimization, and routine account management. Only high-value relationship-based enterprise sales retain a small human workforce.

title: Advertising, promotions, and marketing managers
rationale: AI handles campaign creation, market research analysis, media planning, A/B testing, and content generation autonomously. Human managers remain for brand strategy in ambiguous competitive contexts, high-stakes creative direction where human authorship matters, and executive-level client relationships.

title: Aerospace engineering and operations technologists and technicians
rationale: While AI automates data recording, simulation analysis, and test procedure documentation, the core work involves physical installation, calibration of equipment, hands-on testing of aircraft systems, and maintaining test facilities. The physical and safety-critical nature limits digital exposure.

title: Aerospace engineers
rationale: AI handles detailed design optimization, simulation, structural analysis, and documentation by 2036. Human engineers remain essential for novel system architecture decisions, cross-domain integration challenges, safety certification judgment, and managing the physical testing and manufacturing interface.

title: Agricultural and food science technicians
rationale: This role centers on physical laboratory work including collecting samples, conducting field tests, and operating lab equipment. AI automates data analysis and reporting components, but the hands-on specimen collection, equipment operation, and field work remain human tasks.

title: Agricultural and food scientists
rationale: AI handles literature review, experimental design optimization, data analysis, and modeling of agricultural systems. Human scientists remain for novel hypothesis generation, fieldwork oversight, cross-disciplinary insight, and interpreting results in context of complex ecological systems.

title: Agricultural engineers
rationale: Design calculations, system modeling, and documentation are automated. However, agricultural engineering involves significant fieldwork, site assessment, understanding local soil and water conditions firsthand, and working with farmers on practical implementation—retaining substantial human involvement.

title: Agricultural workers
rationale: Agricultural work is overwhelmingly physical—planting, harvesting, tending livestock, operating equipment in variable outdoor conditions. Digital AI exposure is minimal, limited to some automated monitoring and record-keeping tasks.

title: Air traffic controllers
rationale: AI systems can manage routine traffic separation, sequencing, and flow management. However, regulatory mandates for human oversight, handling of emergency and non-standard situations, and the safety-critical nature of the role ensure humans remain in the loop, even as the cognitive workload shifts dramatically.

title: Aircraft and avionics equipment mechanics and technicians
rationale: The core work is physical—inspecting, repairing, and maintaining aircraft systems by hand in hangars and on tarmacs. AI assists with diagnostics and maintenance scheduling, but the hands-on mechanical and electrical repair work in safety-critical aviation contexts remains human-performed.

title: Airline and commercial pilots
rationale: AI autopilot and autonomous flight systems handle routine operations, but regulatory requirements, passenger trust, and the need for human judgment in emergencies keep pilots in cockpits. The role shifts toward monitoring and exception handling, with significant portions of the traditional skill set automated.

title: Animal care and service workers
rationale: This is almost entirely hands-on physical work—feeding, grooming, exercising, and caring for animals. Digital AI has negligible exposure beyond basic scheduling and record-keeping tools.

title: Announcers and DJs
rationale: AI can generate natural-sounding voice content, curate playlists algorithmically, and produce automated radio programming. Human announcers remain primarily for live events, personality-driven shows where human authenticity is the value proposition, and local community connection.

title: Anthropologists and archeologists
rationale: AI transforms the analytical components—artifact classification, pattern recognition in data, literature synthesis, and report writing. However, fieldwork, ethnographic research requiring cultural immersion, and interpretive scholarship involving nuanced cultural understanding retain significant human roles.

title: Arbitrators, mediators, and conciliators
rationale: AI can analyze case precedents, draft settlement proposals, and handle routine dispute documentation. However, the core value is interpersonal—reading emotional dynamics, building trust between parties, and exercising human judgment in fairness determinations that parties will accept as legitimate.

title: Architects
rationale: AI generates designs, optimizes building performance, ensures code compliance, and produces construction documents. Human architects remain for creative vision where human authorship is valued, client relationship management, complex site-specific judgment, and navigating the intersection of aesthetics, community impact, and regulation.

title: Architectural and engineering managers
rationale: Project coordination, resource allocation, scheduling, and technical review are largely automated. Human managers remain for strategic decision-making, cross-functional leadership, client relationships, and navigating ambiguous situations where organizational and interpersonal judgment is required.

title: Archivists, curators, and museum workers
rationale: AI automates cataloging, digitization, collection analysis, and exhibit content generation. Human roles persist in physical conservation work, curatorial judgment about cultural significance, community engagement, and the interpersonal aspects of museum education and public programming.

title: Art directors
rationale: AI generates visual concepts, layouts, and design variations at scale. Human art directors retain value in establishing creative vision where human authorship matters, managing client relationships, and making aesthetic judgments in ambiguous brand and cultural contexts that require taste and cultural awareness.

title: Assemblers and fabricators
rationale: This is hands-on manufacturing work—assembling parts, using tools, and operating on production lines. Digital AI exposure is minimal, limited to instruction displays and quality tracking systems. The work is physical, not digital.

title: Athletes and sports competitors
rationale: Athletic competition is inherently physical and embodied. AI may assist with training analytics and strategy, but the core product—human physical performance in competition—has essentially zero digital AI exposure.

title: Athletic trainers
rationale: AI automates injury risk assessment, rehabilitation protocol design, and performance analytics. However, the core work involves hands-on physical assessment, manual therapy, taping and bracing, and the interpersonal relationship with athletes that is central to effective sports medicine.

title: Atmospheric scientists, including meteorologists
rationale: Weather modeling, forecast generation, data analysis, and climate research are heavily digital and highly automatable by AI. Human roles remain in communicating forecasts to the public, interpreting novel weather patterns, and research into genuinely new atmospheric phenomena.

title: Audiologists
rationale: AI automates hearing test interpretation, hearing aid programming, and treatment planning from digital data. However, audiologists perform physical examinations, fit devices requiring manual dexterity, and provide patient counseling and education that retain significant human involvement.

title: Automotive body and glass repairers
rationale: This is almost entirely physical skilled trade work—removing dents, replacing glass, painting, and welding automotive body panels. Digital AI exposure is negligible beyond estimate generation and parts ordering.

title: Automotive service technicians and mechanics
rationale: The core work is hands-on mechanical diagnosis and repair. AI enhances diagnostic capabilities through OBD systems, but the physical repair, parts replacement, and hands-on troubleshooting remain fundamentally human tasks requiring manual skill.

title: Bakers
rationale: Baking is hands-on physical production work—mixing, shaping, baking, and decorating food products. Digital AI has minimal exposure beyond recipe management and inventory systems.

title: Barbers, hairstylists, and cosmetologists
rationale: Hair cutting, styling, and cosmetic services are entirely hands-on, interpersonal services. The value proposition includes human connection and personal attention. Digital AI exposure is limited to booking systems and trend reference.

title: Bartenders
rationale: Bartending is a physical and interpersonal service role—mixing drinks, managing a bar, and providing social interaction. Digital AI has minimal relevance beyond POS systems and inventory management.

title: Bill and account collectors
rationale: Account identification, contact scheduling, payment processing, and routine collection communications are fully automatable. AI agents handle the vast majority of debt collection workflows. Only complex negotiations with high-value accounts or legally sensitive situations retain human involvement.

title: Biochemists and biophysicists
rationale: AI transforms data analysis, literature synthesis, molecular modeling, experimental design, and paper writing. However, wet lab work, novel hypothesis generation from cross-disciplinary intuition, and interpreting unexpected experimental results in complex biological systems retain meaningful human roles.

title: Bioengineers and biomedical engineers
rationale: Design optimization, simulation, regulatory documentation, and data analysis are automated. Human engineers remain for novel device conceptualization, clinical interface work, navigating complex regulatory pathways requiring judgment, and the physical prototyping and testing phases.

title: Biological technicians
rationale: The role splits between lab bench work (physical sample preparation, running experiments, maintaining equipment) and data tasks. AI automates the data analysis and reporting side, but hands-on laboratory procedures remain human-performed.

title: Boilermakers
rationale: Boilermaking involves physically assembling, installing, and repairing boilers, tanks, and vats in industrial settings. This is heavy manual skilled trade work with negligible digital AI exposure.

title: Bookkeeping, accounting, and auditing clerks
rationale: Basic bookkeeping—recording transactions, reconciling accounts, processing payroll, maintaining ledgers—is entirely digital routine work that AI systems handle end-to-end by 2036. This occupation has effectively ceased to exist in its traditional form.

title: Broadcast, sound, and video technicians
rationale: AI automates video editing, audio mixing, color correction, and routine broadcast operations. However, live event production, physical equipment setup and maintenance, and creative technical decisions in complex production environments retain human roles.

title: Budget analysts
rationale: Budget preparation, variance analysis, financial forecasting, and compliance reporting are structured digital tasks fully automatable by AI. The remaining human role is in strategic budget prioritization discussions with leadership and navigating politically sensitive allocation decisions.

title: Bus drivers
rationale: Bus driving is primarily a physical operation role. While autonomous vehicle technology may transform this occupation, that represents physical AI/robotics rather than digital AI exposure. Digital AI exposure is limited to route optimization and scheduling systems.

title: Butchers
rationale: Butchering is hands-on physical work involving cutting, trimming, and preparing meat products. Digital AI exposure is negligible, limited to inventory and ordering systems.

title: Calibration technologists and technicians
rationale: The core work involves physically inspecting, testing, and adjusting precision instruments and equipment. AI assists with calibration data analysis and documentation, but the hands-on measurement and adjustment work remains human-performed.

title: Cardiovascular technologists and technicians
rationale: AI automates image interpretation, diagnostic analysis, and reporting. However, operating imaging equipment, positioning patients, and performing invasive procedures like cardiac catheterization require physical presence and manual skill that retains human involvement.

title: Career and technical education teachers
rationale: Theoretical content delivery and curriculum planning are automated. However, CTE teaching inherently involves hands-on skills instruction—demonstrating trades, supervising workshop practice, and mentoring students in applied settings—which preserves significant human roles.

title: Carpenters
rationale: Carpentry is skilled physical trade work—measuring, cutting, shaping, and installing wood and other materials on construction sites. Digital AI exposure is minimal, limited to design reference and measurement tools.

title: Cartographers and photogrammetrists
rationale: Map production, geospatial data processing, satellite imagery analysis, and terrain modeling are highly digital tasks that AI handles autonomously. Human roles persist in novel cartographic interpretation, quality assurance for critical applications, and specialized fieldwork.

title: Cashiers
rationale: While self-checkout and automated payment systems reduce cashier roles, this is primarily a physical retail presence job. The digital AI component is limited—the displacement comes more from physical automation (self-checkout kiosks) than digital AI specifically.

title: Chefs and head cooks
rationale: Cooking is fundamentally physical and creative hands-on work. AI can assist with menu planning, recipe optimization, and inventory management, but the core value—culinary creativity, kitchen leadership, and physical food preparation—remains human.

title: Chemical engineers
rationale: Process simulation, reaction modeling, and documentation are automated. However, chemical engineering involves significant plant-floor presence, physical process oversight, and hands-on troubleshooting in industrial environments that retain human roles alongside the digital transformation.

title: Chemical technicians
rationale: The role centers on physical laboratory and plant work—conducting tests, preparing chemical solutions, and operating equipment. AI automates data analysis and reporting, but hands-on lab procedures and quality testing remain human-performed.

title: Chemists and materials scientists
rationale: AI excels at molecular modeling, literature analysis, experimental design optimization, and data interpretation. Human scientists remain for wet lab work, novel hypothesis generation, interpreting surprising results, and cross-disciplinary research requiring intuitive leaps.

title: Childcare workers
rationale: Childcare is fundamentally physical and interpersonal—supervising, nurturing, feeding, and engaging children. Human presence and emotional connection are the core product. Digital AI has negligible exposure beyond administrative record-keeping.

title: Chiropractors
rationale: Chiropractic care is primarily hands-on physical therapy involving spinal manipulation and manual adjustments. AI assists with diagnostic imaging interpretation and treatment planning, but the physical treatment delivery and patient relationship remain entirely human.

title: Civil engineering technologists and technicians
rationale: Drafting, calculation, and plan review components are automated by AI. However, field surveying, construction site inspection, materials testing, and physical oversight of infrastructure projects retain significant human roles.

title: Civil engineers
rationale: Structural analysis, design optimization, code compliance checking, and documentation are automated. Human civil engineers remain for complex site-specific judgment, managing stakeholder relationships, navigating permitting processes, and overseeing physical construction.

title: Claims adjusters, appraisers, examiners, and investigators
rationale: Claims processing, damage assessment from photos and documents, coverage determination, and settlement calculation are structured digital tasks AI handles end-to-end. Only complex fraud investigations, disputed claims requiring negotiation, and catastrophic loss situations retain human adjusters.

title: Clinical laboratory technologists and technicians
rationale: AI automates result interpretation, quality control analysis, and reporting. However, specimen processing, equipment maintenance, troubleshooting instrument malfunctions, and handling non-standard samples require physical laboratory presence.

title: Coaches and scouts
rationale: While AI transforms performance analytics, game strategy, and talent evaluation from video, coaching is fundamentally interpersonal—motivating athletes, building team culture, and making real-time physical-context decisions. Scouting retains the need for in-person evaluation of intangibles.

title: Community health workers
rationale: AI automates health education content creation, resource referral matching, and data tracking. However, the core value is interpersonal—building trust with underserved communities, providing culturally sensitive outreach, and connecting people to services through personal relationships.

title: Compensation and benefits managers
rationale: Compensation benchmarking, benefits administration, compliance tracking, and market analysis are fully automated digital tasks. Human managers remain for strategic compensation philosophy decisions, executive negotiation, and navigating complex organizational politics around pay equity.

title: Compensation, benefits, and job analysis specialists
rationale: Job analysis, salary surveys, benefits comparison, classification systems, and compliance documentation are structured digital tasks AI handles autonomously. Only novel organizational design questions and sensitive employee communications retain human involvement.

title: Compliance officers
rationale: Regulatory monitoring, policy documentation, audit trail analysis, and compliance reporting are automated. Human officers remain for interpreting ambiguous regulations, managing relationships with regulators, handling whistleblower investigations, and exercising judgment in novel compliance gray areas.

title: Computer and information research scientists
rationale: AI automates literature review, code implementation, experimental execution, and paper drafting. Human researchers remain for identifying genuinely novel research directions, cross-disciplinary insight, and theoretical breakthroughs. The occupation is restructured but the frontier research role persists.

title: Computer and information systems managers
rationale: IT planning, system monitoring, vendor evaluation, and technical documentation are automated. Human managers remain for organizational IT strategy, managing cross-functional stakeholder relationships, cybersecurity crisis response, and aligning technology with business objectives in ambiguous contexts.

title: Computer hardware engineers
rationale: Circuit design, simulation, testing analysis, and documentation are automated. Human engineers remain for novel architecture decisions, physical prototyping, lab testing, and cross-domain integration challenges at the hardware-software interface.

title: Computer network architects
rationale: Network design, capacity planning, security architecture, and documentation are highly automatable digital tasks. Human architects remain for novel enterprise-scale integration challenges, strategic technology decisions, and vendor relationship management.

title: Computer programmers
rationale: Pure code implementation from specifications is exactly the task AI excels at by 2036. The traditional programmer role—translating designs into code—has been fully automated. Remaining software roles are at the architecture, product, and strategy level, which are distinct occupations.

title: Computer support specialists
rationale: Troubleshooting, ticket resolution, system configuration, and technical documentation are automated by AI agents. Human specialists remain for complex physical hardware issues, sensitive user situations, and novel problems that fall outside automated resolution patterns.

title: Computer systems analysts
rationale: Requirements gathering, system evaluation, workflow analysis, and implementation planning are structured analytical tasks AI handles end-to-end. The remaining human role is in navigating complex organizational politics, stakeholder management, and genuinely novel system integration challenges.

title: Concierges
rationale: AI handles recommendation generation, booking, information lookup, and routine guest requests. However, the premium concierge role exists precisely for personal human connection, reading subtle social cues, and providing the warmth and discretion that luxury hospitality demands.

title: Conservation scientists and foresters
rationale: AI automates land survey analysis, forest inventory modeling, environmental impact assessments, and management plan documentation. However, significant fieldwork—assessing terrain, evaluating ecosystems in person, and managing land use—requires physical presence and environmental judgment.

title: Construction and building inspectors
rationale: AI automates code compliance checking from plans and documentation. However, physical site inspection—examining structural integrity, verifying installations, identifying safety hazards in person—remains fundamentally human and is the core of the role.

title: Construction equipment operators
rationale: Operating heavy machinery on construction sites is entirely physical work. While GPS guidance and autonomous equipment represent physical automation, digital AI exposure per se is minimal, limited to equipment monitoring systems.

title: Construction laborers and helpers
rationale: Construction labor is physically demanding manual work—carrying materials, digging, mixing concrete, and assisting skilled trades on job sites. Digital AI has essentially no exposure to this work.

title: Construction managers
rationale: AI automates scheduling, cost estimation, document management, and compliance tracking. However, construction management requires substantial on-site presence, managing subcontractor relationships, resolving physical construction problems, and navigating complex interpersonal dynamics with crews and clients.

title: Cooks
rationale: Cooking is hands-on physical work—preparing food, operating kitchen equipment, and managing a fast-paced physical environment. Digital AI exposure is negligible beyond recipe and inventory systems.

title: Correctional officers and bailiffs
rationale: Correctional work is fundamentally physical presence and interpersonal authority—maintaining order, supervising inmates, conducting searches, and responding to incidents. AI assists with monitoring and documentation but the core role requires human physical presence.

title: Cost estimators
rationale: Cost estimation from plans, specifications, and historical data is a structured digital analytical task that AI handles end-to-end. AI processes drawings, calculates material quantities, applies pricing databases, and generates detailed estimates. Only novel or highly complex projects retain human estimator involvement.

title: Court reporters and simultaneous captioners
rationale: Real-time speech-to-text transcription is a task AI performs with superhuman accuracy by 2036. The traditional court reporter role of verbatim transcription has been fully automated, though some jurisdictions may retain human oversight for legal proceedings.

title: Craft and fine artists
rationale: Fine art and craft involve physical creation—sculpting, painting, ceramics, glassblowing. While AI generates digital art, the value of handmade physical artwork and human artistic authorship preserves this role. Digital tools are supplementary rather than displacing.

title: Credit counselors
rationale: Financial analysis, debt management plan creation, budgeting, and credit report review are automated. However, credit counseling has a significant interpersonal component—motivating behavioral change, providing emotional support during financial stress, and building client trust—that retains some human roles.

title: Customer service representatives
rationale: Routine customer inquiries, complaint handling, order processing, and account management are fully automated by AI agents by 2036. The traditional customer service representative role has ceased to exist, replaced by AI with human escalation only for the most complex or sensitive situations.

title: Dancers and choreographers
rationale: Dance is fundamentally embodied physical performance art. While AI can assist with music selection and movement visualization, the core product is human physical expression. Choreography retains more digital exposure through AI-assisted creation tools, but the art form is inherently physical.

title: Data scientists
rationale: Data cleaning, exploratory analysis, model building, feature engineering, and routine insight generation are fully automated. Human data scientists remain for framing novel business questions, interpreting results in complex organizational contexts, and communicating findings to stakeholders.

title: Database administrators and architects
rationale: Database management, query optimization, backup procedures, security configuration, and schema design are structured digital tasks AI handles autonomously. Human roles persist only for novel architecture decisions in complex enterprise environments and strategic data governance.

title: Delivery truck drivers and driver/sales workers
rationale: Driving and package delivery are physical tasks. While route optimization is digitally automated, the core work of operating vehicles and physically delivering packages has minimal digital AI exposure. Autonomous delivery represents physical automation, not digital AI exposure.

title: Dental and ophthalmic laboratory technicians and medical appliance technicians
rationale: AI automates design from digital impressions and specifications, but the physical fabrication of dental prosthetics, eyewear, and medical devices—grinding, polishing, molding, and fitting—remains hands-on skilled work.

title: Dental assistants
rationale: Dental assisting is primarily physical chairside work—preparing instruments, assisting during procedures, taking X-rays, and sterilizing equipment. AI automates scheduling and records management, but the hands-on clinical support role remains human.

title: Dental hygienists
rationale: Dental hygiene involves hands-on clinical procedures—cleaning teeth, applying sealants, taking X-rays, and examining patients' mouths. AI assists with patient education and record-keeping, but the physical clinical work remains human-performed.

title: Dentists
rationale: AI automates diagnostic imaging interpretation, treatment planning, and administrative tasks. However, dental procedures are inherently physical—drilling, filling, extracting, and performing oral surgery require manual dexterity and in-person patient care. The patient relationship also retains human value.

title: Desktop publishers
rationale: Layout design, formatting, and document preparation from provided content are entirely digital tasks that AI handles end-to-end. This occupation has effectively ceased to exist in its traditional form, absorbed by AI-powered publishing tools.

title: Diagnostic medical sonographers
rationale: AI automates image interpretation and reporting. However, performing ultrasound examinations requires physical transducer manipulation, real-time adjustment based on patient anatomy, and patient interaction—skills that retain the human role despite automated analysis.

title: Diesel service technicians and mechanics
rationale: Diesel repair is hands-on mechanical work—diagnosing engine problems, replacing parts, and performing maintenance on heavy vehicles. AI assists with diagnostics, but the physical repair work in garages and on roadsides remains human.

title: Dietitians and nutritionists
rationale: AI generates personalized meal plans, analyzes nutritional data, and produces dietary recommendations from health data. However, patient counseling, motivational interviewing for behavioral change, and working with complex medical cases requiring interpersonal sensitivity retain human dietitians.

title: Drafters
rationale: Technical drawing, CAD work, and producing construction documents from engineer specifications are structured digital tasks AI handles autonomously by 2036. The traditional drafter role is largely automated, with remaining work folded into engineering positions.

title: Drywall installers, ceiling tile installers, and tapers
rationale: This is entirely physical skilled trade work—hanging drywall, taping joints, applying compound, and installing ceiling tiles. Digital AI has essentially no exposure to this occupation.

title: Economists
rationale: Data analysis, econometric modeling, forecasting, literature review, and report writing are automated. Human economists remain for novel theoretical frameworks, interpreting results in complex policy contexts, advising decision-makers on ambiguous trade-offs, and public communication of economic concepts.

title: Editors
rationale: Copy editing, fact-checking, formatting, and routine content editing are fully automated. Human editors remain for high-level editorial vision, managing creative relationships with authors, and making judgment calls about tone and audience in prestigious or sensitive publications.

title: Electrical and electronic engineering technologists and technicians
rationale: AI automates circuit analysis, testing data interpretation, and documentation. However, the core work involves physical hands-on tasks—building prototypes, testing circuits, calibrating equipment, and troubleshooting hardware in labs and manufacturing floors.

title: Electrical and electronics engineers
rationale: Circuit design, simulation, analysis, and documentation are automated. Human engineers remain for novel system architecture, physical prototyping and testing, cross-domain integration challenges, and managing the interface between digital design and physical manufacturing.

title: Electrical and electronics installers and repairers
rationale: This is hands-on physical work—installing, maintaining, and repairing electrical equipment. AI assists with diagnostics and troubleshooting guides, but the physical installation and repair work remains human-performed.

title: Electrical power-line installers and repairers
rationale: Line work is physically demanding outdoor labor—climbing poles, stringing wire, and repairing power lines often in dangerous weather conditions. Digital AI has essentially no exposure to this occupation beyond outage mapping systems.

title: Electricians
rationale: Electrical work is hands-on skilled trade work—running wire, installing fixtures, troubleshooting circuits in buildings and construction sites. AI assists with code lookup and load calculations, but the core physical work remains entirely human.

title: Electro-mechanical and mechatronics technologists and technicians
rationale: AI automates testing data analysis and documentation. However, the role centers on physical work—assembling, testing, and maintaining electromechanical devices and automated manufacturing systems, requiring hands-on skills.

title: Elementary, middle, and high school principals
rationale: AI automates administrative tasks like scheduling, budgeting, data analysis, compliance reporting, and communication drafting. However, school leadership is fundamentally interpersonal—building school culture, managing staff, engaging parents, handling disciplinary situations, and community relations.

title: Elevator and escalator installers and repairers
rationale: Installing and repairing elevators is physically demanding, highly specialized mechanical work. AI assists with diagnostics and maintenance scheduling, but the hands-on installation, repair, and safety testing remain human-performed.

title: Emergency management directors
rationale: AI automates risk modeling, resource allocation planning, communication systems, and situation monitoring. However, emergency management requires real-time human judgment in crisis situations, inter-agency coordination, public communication under pressure, and community relationship building.

title: EMTs and paramedics
rationale: Emergency medical response is fundamentally physical—transporting patients, performing life-saving procedures, and making rapid assessments in the field. AI assists with protocol guidance and hospital communication, but the hands-on emergency care in uncontrolled environments remains human.

title: Entertainment and recreation managers
rationale: AI automates scheduling, financial management, marketing, and administrative tasks. However, managing entertainment venues and programs requires physical presence, staff leadership, event oversight, and creating experiences that depend on human interpersonal skills.

title: Environmental engineering technologists and technicians
rationale: AI automates data analysis, environmental modeling, and report writing. However, field sampling, site inspections, equipment operation, and environmental monitoring in the field require physical presence and hands-on work.

title: Environmental engineers
rationale: Environmental modeling, regulatory compliance analysis, remediation design, and impact assessment documentation are automated. Human engineers remain for site-specific judgment, stakeholder engagement, novel contamination scenarios, and navigating complex regulatory negotiations.

title: Environmental science and protection technicians
rationale: The role involves substantial fieldwork—collecting samples, conducting inspections, monitoring pollution. AI automates lab data analysis and reporting, but physical sample collection, site assessment, and field monitoring remain human tasks.

title: Environmental scientists and specialists
rationale: AI automates data analysis, environmental modeling, literature review, and report generation. Human scientists remain for fieldwork, novel research questions, interpreting complex ecosystem interactions, and communicating findings to policymakers and communities.

title: Epidemiologists
rationale: Disease surveillance, statistical analysis, outbreak modeling, and report writing are highly automatable digital tasks. Human epidemiologists remain for novel pathogen investigation, study design in ambiguous situations, and communicating complex health risks to policymakers and the public.

title: Exercise physiologists
rationale: AI automates exercise program design and physiological data analysis. However, the core work involves hands-on patient assessment, supervising exercise sessions, and providing motivational coaching—physical and interpersonal tasks that remain human.

title: Farmers, ranchers, and other agricultural managers
rationale: AI automates crop planning, market analysis, financial management, and precision agriculture data. However, farming and ranching are fundamentally physical—managing land, equipment, livestock, and workers in variable outdoor conditions with constant hands-on decision-making.

title: Fashion designers
rationale: AI generates design concepts, creates patterns, produces technical specifications, and handles trend analysis. Human designers retain value for creative vision where human authorship is the brand, understanding cultural and social dynamics, client relationships, and physical fabric and fit expertise.

title: Film and video editors and camera operators
rationale: AI automates routine editing, color correction, and assembly cuts. Camera operation requires physical presence and creative framing judgment. Human editors and operators remain for creative storytelling decisions, live event coverage, and premium productions where human artistic vision is valued.

title: Financial analysts
rationale: Financial modeling, market analysis, report generation, and investment screening are structured digital tasks AI handles autonomously. Human analysts remain for novel strategic insights, relationship-based advisory work, and interpreting market dynamics in unprecedented situations.

title: Financial clerks
rationale: Processing financial transactions, maintaining records, billing, and payment handling are routine digital tasks fully automated by 2036. This occupation has effectively ceased to exist in its traditional form.

title: Financial examiners
rationale: Reviewing financial records, assessing compliance, and producing examination reports are structured analytical tasks AI handles. Human examiners remain for complex fraud investigations, interpreting ambiguous regulatory situations, and exercising enforcement judgment.

title: Financial managers
rationale: Financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and compliance management are automated. Human financial managers remain for strategic financial planning in ambiguous business contexts, stakeholder relationships, capital allocation decisions, and organizational leadership.

title: Fire inspectors
rationale: AI automates code compliance analysis and report generation. However, fire inspection requires physical building walkthroughs, on-site evaluation of fire hazards, and investigation of fire scenes—hands-on work that retains significant human involvement.

title: Firefighters
rationale: Firefighting is fundamentally physical emergency response—entering burning buildings, operating equipment, rescuing people, and providing medical aid. Digital AI has minimal exposure, limited to dispatch optimization and incident documentation.

title: Fishing and hunting workers
rationale: Fishing and hunting are entirely physical outdoor occupations involving operating boats, deploying nets and traps, and processing catch. Digital AI has negligible exposure beyond navigation and weather tools.

title: Fitness trainers and instructors
rationale: AI generates workout programs and tracks fitness data. However, personal training is fundamentally interpersonal—motivating clients, correcting form in person, and providing accountability through human relationships. The social and physical nature of group fitness also retains human instructors.

title: Flight attendants
rationale: Flight attendant work is physical and interpersonal—ensuring passenger safety, serving food and beverages, managing cabin situations, and providing customer service in a physical aircraft. Digital AI has minimal direct exposure.

title: Flooring installers and tile and stone setters
rationale: Installing flooring, tile, and stone is entirely hands-on physical skilled trade work requiring precise cutting, laying, and finishing. Digital AI has essentially no exposure to this occupation.

title: Floral designers
rationale: Floral design is hands-on creative physical work—selecting, cutting, and arranging flowers. While AI can suggest designs, the physical creation and the artisanal nature of the work remain human. Digital exposure is limited to ordering and design reference.

title: Food and beverage serving and related workers
rationale: Serving food and beverages is physical interpersonal work—taking orders, carrying plates, and interacting with customers. Digital AI exposure is limited to ordering systems and POS technology.

title: Food preparation workers
rationale: Food preparation is entirely hands-on physical work—washing, cutting, measuring, and preparing ingredients. Digital AI has negligible exposure to this occupation.

title: Food processing equipment workers
rationale: Operating food processing machinery is physical production work. AI assists with quality monitoring and process control, but operating, cleaning, and maintaining processing equipment remains hands-on.

title: Food service managers
rationale: AI automates inventory management, scheduling, cost analysis, and menu optimization. However, food service management requires physical presence—overseeing kitchen operations, managing staff in person, handling customer issues, and ensuring quality through direct observation.

title: Forensic science technicians
rationale: AI automates evidence analysis (DNA matching, fingerprint comparison, digital forensics) and report generation. However, physical evidence collection at crime scenes, maintaining chain of custody, and testifying in court retain significant human roles.

title: Forest and conservation workers
rationale: Forest conservation work is physical outdoor labor—planting trees, fighting fires, maintaining trails, and managing forest land. Digital AI has negligible exposure to this occupation.

title: Fundraisers
rationale: AI automates prospect research, campaign analytics, grant writing, donor communications, and event planning logistics. rationale: AI automates ventilator management protocols and diagnostic data analysis. However, respiratory therapy involves hands-on clinical work—managing airways, operating respiratory equipment, and providing direct patient care in critical care settings.

title: Retail sales workers
rationale: Retail sales is primarily a physical presence role—assisting customers in stores, arranging merchandise, and operating registers. E-commerce automation displaces some roles, but in-store retail remains a physical and interpersonal occupation with limited digital AI exposure.

title: Roofers
rationale: Roofing is entirely physical manual labor—installing and repairing roofs in outdoor conditions. This is the prototypical zero digital AI exposure occupation alongside janitorial work.

title: Sales engineers
rationale: AI automates technical proposal generation, product configuration, pricing, and competitive analysis. Human sales engineers remain for complex technical consultations, building customer relationships, and translating between technical and business stakeholders in high-value enterprise sales.

title: Sales managers
rationale: AI automates sales forecasting, pipeline analysis, territory optimization, and performance reporting. Human sales managers remain for team leadership, coaching sales representatives, managing key client relationships, and strategic market positioning requiring interpersonal judgment.

title: School and career counselors and advisors
rationale: AI automates career matching, academic planning, college application guidance, and resource referrals. However, counseling involves deep interpersonal work—supporting students through personal crises, building trust with adolescents, and navigating sensitive family dynamics.

title: Secretaries and administrative assistants
rationale: Scheduling, correspondence, document preparation, filing, and administrative coordination are entirely digital routine tasks that AI handles end-to-end. This occupation has effectively ceased to exist in its traditional form, replaced by AI executive assistants.

title: Securities, commodities, and financial services sales agents
rationale: Trade execution, market analysis, portfolio construction, and client reporting are automated. Human agents persist for high-net-worth relationship management, complex financial product advisory, and situations where client trust in a human advisor drives business.

title: Security guards and gambling surveillance officers
rationale: Security guard work is physical presence—patrolling premises, monitoring entrances, and responding to incidents. AI enhances surveillance systems, but the human deterrent and response function requires physical presence.

title: Semiconductor processing technicians
rationale: Operating semiconductor fabrication equipment is hands-on cleanroom work. AI automates process monitoring and yield analysis, but physical equipment operation, maintenance, and quality inspection in fabrication facilities remain human tasks.

title: Set and exhibit designers
rationale: AI generates design concepts, 3D visualizations, and technical drawings. However, set and exhibit design involves physical construction oversight, understanding spatial dynamics in person, and creative vision in the context of live performances and physical exhibitions.

title: Sheet metal workers
rationale: Sheet metal work is physical skilled trade work—cutting, bending, and installing metal sheets in construction and manufacturing. Digital AI has essentially no exposure to this occupation.

title: Skincare specialists
rationale: Skincare treatment is hands-on physical service work—performing facials, applying treatments, and providing personal beauty care. The interpersonal pampering experience is the core product. Digital AI has minimal exposure beyond booking and product recommendation.

title: Small engine mechanics
rationale: Repairing lawn mowers, chainsaws, and other small engines is hands-on mechanical work. AI assists with diagnostics, but the physical disassembly, repair, and reassembly remain human tasks.

title: Social and community service managers
rationale: AI automates program evaluation, grant writing, data reporting, and resource allocation analysis. However, managing social service organizations requires staff leadership, community relationship building, advocacy, and navigating complex inter-agency dynamics.

title: Social and human service assistants
rationale: AI automates intake documentation, resource referral matching, and case tracking. However, the role involves direct client interaction—assisting vulnerable populations, accompanying clients to appointments, and providing emotional support that requires human presence and empathy.

title: Social workers
rationale: AI automates assessment tools, documentation, resource identification, and case management tracking. However, social work is fundamentally interpersonal—building relationships with vulnerable clients, conducting home visits, crisis intervention, and advocating for clients in complex systems.

title: Sociologists
rationale: Data analysis, survey design, literature synthesis, and report writing are automated. Human sociologists remain for novel theoretical frameworks, ethnographic research requiring cultural immersion, and interpretive scholarship about social dynamics that requires human understanding.

title: Software developers, quality assurance analysts, and testers
rationale: Code implementation, testing, debugging, and routine software development are automated. The occupation is fundamentally restructured—remaining human roles focus on product vision, system architecture, and strategic technical leadership. QA testing as traditionally defined is fully automated.

title: Solar photovoltaic installers
rationale: Solar panel installation is physical rooftop work—mounting panels, running wiring, and connecting systems. Digital AI has essentially no exposure to this occupation.

title: Special education teachers
rationale: AI automates IEP documentation, adaptive curriculum generation, and progress tracking. However, special education requires intensive interpersonal work—building relationships with students who have diverse disabilities, physical assistance, behavioral management, and family collaboration.

title: Special effects artists and animators
rationale: AI generates animations, visual effects, and 3D modeling from descriptions. Routine animation production is automated. Human artists remain for creative direction in premium productions, novel artistic styles, and situations where human artistic vision is the value proposition.

title: Speech-language pathologists
rationale: AI automates assessment scoring and therapy exercise generation. However, speech therapy is hands-on and interpersonal—direct patient interaction, observing and correcting speech patterns in real-time, and building therapeutic relationships, especially with children and stroke patients.

title: Stationary engineers and boiler operators
rationale: Operating and maintaining boilers and mechanical systems in buildings is physical operations work. AI automates monitoring and scheduling, but hands-on equipment operation, maintenance, and emergency response in mechanical rooms remain human tasks.

title: Substance abuse, behavioral disorder, and mental health counselors
rationale: AI provides psychoeducation tools and treatment planning support. However, counseling addicted and mentally ill individuals is deeply interpersonal—the therapeutic relationship, group facilitation, crisis intervention, and motivational interviewing require human empathy and presence.

title: Surgical assistants and technologists
rationale: Surgical technology is hands-on clinical work—preparing operating rooms, sterilizing instruments, passing instruments during surgery, and maintaining the sterile field. AI assists with surgical planning, but the physical operating room role remains human.

title: Survey researchers
rationale: Survey design, data collection, statistical analysis, and report generation are structured digital tasks AI handles autonomously. Human researchers remain for novel research question formulation and interpreting results in complex social science contexts.

title: Surveying and mapping technicians
rationale: AI automates data processing, map production, and calculations. However, physical fieldwork—operating survey instruments, collecting GPS data, and marking boundaries on-site—retains significant human roles.

title: Surveyors
rationale: AI automates boundary calculations, legal description analysis, and map production. However, physical site measurement, equipment operation in the field, and professional certification requirements for legal surveys retain human roles.

title: Tax examiners and collectors, and revenue agents
rationale: Tax return review, compliance checking, and collection processing are structured digital tasks AI handles autonomously. Human agents remain for complex fraud investigations, taxpayer disputes requiring negotiation, and novel tax situations.

title: Taxi drivers, shuttle drivers, and chauffeurs
rationale: Driving is a physical task. While autonomous vehicle technology may transform this occupation, that represents physical automation rather than digital AI exposure. Digital AI exposure is limited to navigation and dispatch systems.

title: Teacher assistants
rationale: AI automates instructional content delivery, grading, and documentation. However, teacher assistants provide direct physical support to students—supervising, managing behavior, assisting with special needs, and maintaining a supportive classroom presence.

title: Technical writers
rationale: Documentation, user manuals, API references, and technical content creation from source material are structured digital tasks AI handles end-to-end. The traditional technical writer role is fundamentally restructured, with remaining human work in strategic content architecture and complex product communication.

title: Telecommunications technicians
rationale: Installing and repairing telecommunications equipment is hands-on physical work. AI assists with diagnostics and network configuration, but the physical installation, cable routing, and hardware repair remain human tasks.

title: Tellers
rationale: Banking transactions, account inquiries, and routine financial services are handled by ATMs, online banking, and AI. The traditional teller role has been fundamentally restructured, with remaining human roles focused on complex transactions and relationship banking.

title: Top executives
rationale: AI automates data analysis, report generation, market intelligence, and strategic scenario modeling. However, executive leadership requires interpersonal influence, organizational vision, stakeholder relationship management, and making high-stakes decisions in ambiguous contexts where human accountability is essential.

title: Tour and travel guides
rationale: AI automates itinerary planning, information delivery, and travel recommendations. However, tour guiding is an in-person interpersonal experience—leading groups through physical locations, providing engaging storytelling, and adapting to real-time group dynamics.

title: Training and development managers
rationale: AI automates training content creation, needs assessment, program evaluation, and learning analytics. Human managers remain for organizational learning strategy, facilitating executive development, and managing the interpersonal aspects of organizational change.

title: Training and development specialists
rationale: Course design, content creation, assessment development, and delivery of standard training are automated by AI. Human specialists remain for facilitation of complex interpersonal skill development, executive coaching, and organizational development interventions requiring human facilitation.

title: Transportation, storage, and distribution managers
rationale: AI automates route optimization, inventory management, demand forecasting, and logistics planning. Human managers remain for crisis response, labor management, regulatory navigation, and managing complex multi-modal transportation networks requiring interpersonal coordination.

title: Travel agents
rationale: Itinerary planning, booking, price comparison, and travel logistics are fully automated by AI. The traditional travel agent role has been fundamentally restructured—human agents persist only for luxury and complex multi-destination travel where personalized advisory service commands a premium.

title: Tutors
rationale: AI provides personalized instruction, practice problems, explanations, and progress tracking that replicate much of traditional tutoring. Human tutors remain for motivational coaching, working with students who need interpersonal connection, and high-stakes test preparation where human accountability is valued.

title: Umpires, referees, and other sports officials
rationale: Officiating sports is physical on-field work. While AI assists with instant replay and decision support, the human official remains for real-time game management, player interaction, and maintaining the human element that sports culture values.

title: Urban and regional planners
rationale: AI automates demographic analysis, zoning code review, environmental impact modeling, and plan documentation. Human planners remain for community engagement, navigating political dynamics, creative placemaking vision, and balancing competing stakeholder interests in complex urban decisions.

title: Veterinarians
rationale: AI automates diagnostic imaging interpretation, treatment protocol recommendations, and medical records. However, veterinary medicine is hands-on—physical examinations, surgery, and direct animal care require manual skill. The client relationship with pet owners also retains human value.

title: Veterinary assistants and laboratory animal caretakers
rationale: Working with animals is physical—feeding, cleaning, restraining, and providing basic care. AI assists with documentation and scheduling, but the hands-on animal care remains entirely human.

title: Veterinary technologists and technicians
rationale: Vet techs perform hands-on clinical work—drawing blood, administering medications, assisting in surgery, and monitoring anesthetized animals. AI assists with lab result interpretation, but the physical clinical work remains human.

title: Waiters and waitresses
rationale: Table service is physical and interpersonal—taking orders, carrying food, and providing hospitality. Digital AI exposure is limited to ordering systems and POS technology.

title: Water and wastewater treatment plant and system operators
rationale: AI automates monitoring, process control optimization, and compliance reporting. However, physical plant operations—adjusting equipment, conducting inspections, and maintaining infrastructure—require human presence in regulated utility environments.

title: Water transportation workers
rationale: Operating boats and ships is physical work in marine environments. AI assists with navigation and cargo management, but vessel operation, docking, and maritime safety require human crews.

title: Web developers and digital designers
rationale: Website development, front-end coding, and digital interface design are fully automatable by AI. The traditional web developer role is restructured—remaining human roles focus on creative digital strategy, user experience vision, and complex interactive experiences where human design judgment adds value.

title: Welders, cutters, solderers, and brazers
rationale: Welding is physical skilled trade work—joining metals using heat and filler materials. Digital AI has essentially no exposure to this occupation, which requires hands-on manual skill and physical endurance.

title: Wholesale and manufacturing sales representatives
rationale: AI automates product configuration, pricing, order processing, and market analytics. Human sales representatives remain for complex B2B relationship management, consultative selling in technical domains, and navigating enterprise procurement processes.

title: Wind turbine technicians
rationale: Wind turbine maintenance is physical work performed at height in outdoor conditions. AI assists with predictive maintenance analytics and diagnostics, but the physical climb, inspection, and repair of turbine components remain human tasks.

title: Woodworkers
rationale: Woodworking is physical production work—cutting, shaping, and assembling wood products using hand and power tools. AI assists with CNC design and production planning, but the hands-on craftsmanship remains human.

title: Writers and authors
rationale: AI generates articles, marketing copy, reports, and even long-form content. Routine writing is fully automated. Human writers persist where artistic voice, cultural commentary, investigative journalism, and human authorship are integral to the value proposition.

title: Zoologists and wildlife biologists
rationale: AI automates data analysis, population modeling, literature review, and report writing. However, fieldwork—observing animals in natural habitats, collecting specimens, conducting wildlife surveys—requires physical presence and remains a substantial part of the role.
